academic_review_notes: Distinct readings (CTS digest) exam and Blaikie textbook exam; source passages I–III, X–XI, XVIII–XX, XXI–XXVI, XXX–XXXIII.

15 selected v2 question concepts retained/revised; 25 new interpretation-oriented items. Some retained primary answer words changed to eliminate digest overlap and to test Blaikie rather than Joshua narrative.
Each question includes a precise sentence from the chapter in its source_quote field, verified against locally prepared public-domain Blaikie text.
40 bilingual fill-ins; 8 per group; 20 presented (4 per group); 18/20 to pass.
Primary answer only; add only authentic accepted variants later where meaningful; no artificial filler synonyms.
Not for activation until Spanish versions of the assigned Blaikie passages are online and the Mac build/tests and faculty review succeed.
v2 chapter map superseded by Claude proposed groups.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter I

prompt.en: For Blaikie, the sacred histories frame the unfolding of God's progressive ____ of Himself.
prompt.es: Para Blaikie, las historias sagradas enmarcan la ____ progresiva que Dios hace de sí mismo.

questions.source_quote: The story of the Hebrew nation is but the frame in which this Divine revelation is set.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter I

prompt.en: Blaikie says the promised land was expected to be a scene of unwonted ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie dice que se esperaba que la tierra prometida fuera escenario de una extraordinaria ____.

questions.source_quote: It is vain to account for this extraordinary faith in the land as theirs, and this remarkable assurance that it would be the scene of unwonted blessing, apart from a supernatural communication from God.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter I

prompt.en: Blaikie contends that an account of Old Testament history cannot eliminate the ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie sostiene que un relato de la historia del Antiguo Testamento no puede eliminar lo ____.

questions.source_quote: Se non e vero e bene trovato. In like manner, we believe that to delineate Old Testament history without reference to the supernatural is as impossible as to describe Livingstone apart from his religion.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter I

prompt.en: Blaikie calls the hope woven like a golden thread through Hebrew history ____ hope.
prompt.es: Blaikie llama esperanza ____ a la que atraviesa la historia hebrea como un hilo de oro.

questions.source_quote: With this promise was connected that Messianic hope which like a golden thread ran through all Hebrew history and literature, brightening it more and more as the ages advanced.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter II

prompt.en: Blaikie judges belonging to God's ____ a higher distinction than royal ancestry.
prompt.es: Blaikie considera que pertenecer a la ____ de Dios es una distinción mayor que la ascendencia real.

questions.source_quote: To be of the household of God was higher than to be born of kings.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter II

prompt.en: According to Blaikie, Joshua accepted his appointment with ____ faith rather than self-exaltation.
prompt.es: Según Blaikie, Josué aceptó su nombramiento con fe ____ y no con exaltación propia.

questions.source_quote: He seems to have accepted the appointment with humble faith and spirited enthusiasm, and prepared at once for the perilous enterprise.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter I

prompt.en: In Blaikie's careful distinction, Joshua succeeded Moses only as ____ leader.
prompt.es: En la distinción cuidadosa de Blaikie, Josué sucedió a Moisés solo como dirigente ____.

questions.source_quote: Joshua was no prophet; he made no claim to the prophetic character; he succeeded Moses only as military leader.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter III

prompt.en: Blaikie suggests that a second generation may lack great heroes yet gain wider ____ among ordinary workers.
prompt.es: Blaikie sugiere que una segunda generación puede carecer de grandes héroes y aun así aumentar la ____ entre sus miembros comunes.

questions.source_quote: If in the second generation of any great religious movement few or none can match the "mighties" of the previous age, there may be a general elevation, a rise of level, an increase of efficiency among the rank and file.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter X

prompt.en: Blaikie interprets the naming of Gilgal as testimony that Egypt's ____ had been rolled away.
prompt.es: Blaikie interpreta el nombre de Gilgal como testimonio de que el ____ de Egipto había sido quitado.

questions.source_quote: The name of Gilgal will be a perpetual testimony that the reproach of Egypt is rolled away.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter X

prompt.en: From the cessation of manna, Blaikie draws a law of divine ____: no needless miracle when provision is available.
prompt.es: Del cese del maná, Blaikie deduce una ley de ____ divina: ningún milagro innecesario cuando hay provisión disponible.

questions.source_quote: A law of economy, we might almost say parsimony, prevails, side by side with the exercise of unbounded liberality.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XI

prompt.en: Blaikie distinguishes the heavenly soldier's sword from conquest for greed: it is a ____ sword.
prompt.es: Blaikie distingue la espada del soldado celestial de la conquista por codicia: es una espada ____.

questions.source_quote: It was the judicial sword, demanding the death of men who had been tried for their sins, long warned, and at last judicially condemned.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter X

prompt.en: Following Calvin, Blaikie treats the wilderness interruption of circumcision as a temporary ____ rather than abolition.
prompt.es: Siguiendo a Calvino, Blaikie entiende la interrupción de la circuncisión en el desierto como una ____ temporal, no como abolición.

questions.source_quote: But it was not an abolition, but only a suspension of the sacrament for a time that took place.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter X

prompt.en: Which sacred observance does Blaikie say is designed to look backward and recall God's first great deliverance? ____
prompt.es: ¿Qué observancia sagrada, según Blaikie, mira hacia atrás y recuerda la primera gran liberación divina? ____

questions.source_quote: It was the very nature of the Passover to look back to the past, and to recall God's first great interposition on behalf of His people.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter X

prompt.en: Blaikie teaches that we should not ask for extraordinary help when ____ means are available to us.
prompt.es: Blaikie enseña que no debemos pedir ayuda extraordinaria cuando disponemos de medios ____.

questions.source_quote: We have no right to ask that mercies may come to us through extraordinary channels, when it is in our power to get them by ordinary means.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XI

prompt.en: Blaikie interprets Old Testament divine appearances as foreshadows of the future ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie interpreta las apariciones divinas del Antiguo Testamento como anticipaciones de la futura ____.

questions.source_quote: There seems no good reason to reject the view that these theophanies, though not incarnations, were yet foreshadows of the incarnation,--hints of the mystery afterwards to be realized when Jesus was born of Mary.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XI

prompt.en: What theological term does Blaikie use for the divine appearances that anticipated a fuller disclosure? ____
prompt.es: ¿Qué término teológico emplea Blaikie para las apariciones divinas que anticipaban una revelación más plena? ____

questions.source_quote: There seems no good reason to reject the view that these theophanies, though not incarnations, were yet foreshadows of the incarnation,--hints of the mystery afterwards to be realized when Jesus was born of Mary.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XVIII

prompt.en: Blaikie diagnoses Joshua's error with the Gibeonites partly as ____ rather than simply their clever disguise.
prompt.es: Blaikie diagnostica el error de Josué con los gabaonitas, en parte, como ____ y no solo como efecto de su disfraz.

questions.source_quote: They had been guilty of over-confidence, and of neglect of means that were in their hands; they had neglected to get counsel of their God.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XVIII

prompt.en: Blaikie says the leaders neglected to seek divine ____ before accepting the Gibeonites' story.
prompt.es: Blaikie dice que los dirigentes descuidaron buscar el ____ divino antes de aceptar el relato de los gabaonitas.

questions.source_quote: They had been guilty of over-confidence, and of neglect of means that were in their hands; they had neglected to get counsel of their God.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XIX

prompt.en: Blaikie characterizes the form of the cited passage about the prolonged day as ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie caracteriza la forma del pasaje citado sobre el día prolongado como ____.

questions.source_quote: In form it was poetical, the extract in the present case being of that rhythmical structure which was the mark of Hebrew poetry.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XX

prompt.en: Blaikie stresses that the northern army included horses and ____, a previously unfamiliar form of warfare for Israel.
prompt.es: Blaikie subraya que el ejército del norte contaba con caballos y ____, una forma de guerra antes desconocida para Israel.

questions.source_quote: "Horses and chariots" was an arm unknown to the Israelites, with which hitherto they had never contended.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XVIII

prompt.en: Even after the deception was exposed, Blaikie says the princes would not violate the sanctity of their ____.
prompt.es: Incluso después de descubrir el engaño, Blaikie dice que los príncipes no violarían la santidad de su ____.

questions.source_quote: He and the princes had such respect for the sanctity of an oath that, even when they discovered that they had been grossly deceived, they would not resile from it.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XVIII

prompt.en: Blaikie rebukes the Gibeonites' strategy as an elaborate system of ____ rather than an example to imitate.
prompt.es: Blaikie reprende la estrategia de los gabaonitas como un elaborado sistema de ____ en vez de un ejemplo que imitar.

questions.source_quote: They were to get Him to favour them above their neighbours through an elaborate system of fraud, through a tissue of lies, through unmitigated falsehood.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XIX

prompt.en: Besides the prolonged day, which event does Blaikie credit to divine help in the southern battle? ____
prompt.es: Además del día prolongado, ¿qué acontecimiento atribuye Blaikie a la ayuda divina en la batalla del sur? ____

questions.source_quote: The hailstorm that wrought such havoc was ascribed to His friendly hand, but a far more memorable token of His interest and support lay in the miracle that arrested the movements of the sun and the moon, in order that victorious Israel might have time to finish his work.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XX

prompt.en: Blaikie says the peoples who remained would serve a purpose in God's plan of ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie afirma que los pueblos que permanecieron cumplirían un propósito en el plan divino de ____.

questions.source_quote: Joshua, however, had not received instructions to destroy them; they were left to serve a purpose in God's plan of discipline (Judg. ii. 3), and while Israel was often humbled under them their attacks proved occasions of rallying, bringing them back to God, whose worship they were so ready to neglect.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXIII

prompt.en: Blaikie commends the tribal system as providing ____ within unity rather than obliterating local distinctions.
prompt.es: Blaikie elogia el sistema tribal por ofrecer ____ dentro de la unidad sin borrar las diferencias locales.

questions.source_quote: As in the case of the separate states of North America, or the separate cantons of Switzerland, it provided for variety in unity; it gave a measure of local freedom and independence, while it maintained united action; it contributed to the life and vigour of the commonwealth, without destroying its oneness of character, or impairing its common purpose and aim.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXII

prompt.en: In Blaikie's interpretation, Caleb sought demanding land still harassed by the ____ rather than the easiest allotment.
prompt.es: Según la interpretación de Blaikie, Caleb pidió una región difícil todavía acosada por los ____ en vez de una heredad fácil.

questions.source_quote: Nor was it a portion of the land which any tribe might be eager to enter upon that he asked; for it was still so harassed by the Anakim, that there would be no peace till that formidable body of giants were driven out.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXIII

prompt.en: Blaikie distinguishes western Canaan as the special theatre of divine ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie distingue la Canaán occidental como escenario especial de la ____ divina.

questions.source_quote: The two and a half tribes have already got their settlements on the other side of Jordan; but the other side of Jordan, though included in the land of promise, was outside the part specially consecrated as the theatre of Divine manifestation and dealing.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXV

prompt.en: Blaikie interprets Ephraim's complaint about its share as prompted by ____ of Manasseh.
prompt.es: Blaikie interpreta la queja de Efraín acerca de su porción como motivada por ____ hacia Manasés.

questions.source_quote: But, looking at the whole circumstances, it is probable that Ephraim's complaint was dictated by jealousy of Manasseh, who certainly had received the double inheritance.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXVI

prompt.en: Blaikie says that once civil arrangements were made, the nation's spiritual centre required the erection of the ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie dice que, una vez establecida la organización civil, el centro espiritual de la nación requería erigir el ____.

questions.source_quote: First, a place has to be found as the centre of the religious life; next, the tabernacle has to be erected at that place--and this is to be done in the presence of all the congregation.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXIV

prompt.en: Blaikie calls Judah the ____ tribe, explaining why a conspicuous territory was fitting.
prompt.es: Blaikie llama a Judá la tribu ____ y explica por qué le correspondía un territorio destacado.

questions.source_quote: Judah was the imperial tribe, and it was fitting that he should be planted in a conspicuous territory.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXV

prompt.en: Blaikie warns that Ephraim's privileged standing fostered an ____ spirit.
prompt.es: Blaikie advierte que la posición privilegiada de Efraín fomentó un espíritu ____.

questions.source_quote: The superiority allotted to Ephraim was not followed by very happy results; it raised an arrogant spirit in that tribe, of which we find some indications in the present chapter, but more pronounced and mischievous manifestations further on.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXIII

prompt.en: In describing limits on accumulated property, Blaikie highlights the fiftieth year as the year of ____.
prompt.es: Al describir los límites a la acumulación de propiedades, Blaikie destaca el año cincuenta como el año del ____.

questions.source_quote: At the fiftieth year, the year of jubilee, every inheritance returned, free of all encumbrance, to the representatives of the original proprietor.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXX

prompt.en: Blaikie concludes that the eastern tribes' disputed altar was intended as a ____ rather than a second sacrificial site.
prompt.es: Blaikie concluye que el altar discutido de las tribus orientales se pensó como un ____ y no como otro lugar de sacrificios.

questions.source_quote: It was designed simply as a memorial, not for sacrifices.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXX

prompt.en: Blaikie argues the eastern tribes would have been worse off had they chosen ____ over helping their brethren.
prompt.es: Blaikie sostiene que las tribus orientales habrían terminado peor si hubieran elegido el ____ en vez de ayudar a sus hermanos.

questions.source_quote: Had these two tribes and a half chosen the alternative of selfishness, refused to cross the Jordan to help their brethren, and devoted their whole energies at once to their fields and flocks, they would have fared worse in the end.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXX

prompt.en: Blaikie warns that attempts to reinforce tribal unity almost produced a disastrous ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie advierte que el intento de reforzar la unidad tribal casi produjo un desastroso ____.

questions.source_quote: In their effort to promote unity, they had almost occasioned a fatal schism.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXXI

prompt.en: In his theological summary, Blaikie explicitly depicts God as Israel's ____ in its battles.
prompt.es: En su resumen teológico, Blaikie presenta explícitamente a Dios como el ____ de Israel en sus batallas.

questions.source_quote: God is expressly set forth as the champion of Israel, fighting for him against the Canaanites, and driving them out.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXXI

prompt.en: Blaikie says human failures must not be blamed on God when divine and human work appear in ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie sostiene que no deben atribuirse a Dios los fallos humanos cuando la obra divina y humana aparece en ____.

questions.source_quote: Where God and man are in partnership, we may expect a chequered product, but never let us ascribe the flaws of one to the influence of the other.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXXII

prompt.en: Blaikie says Joshua deliberately appealed to the people's reason and demanded a considered religious ____.
prompt.es: Blaikie dice que Josué apeló deliberadamente a la razón del pueblo y exigió una ____ religiosa meditada.

questions.source_quote: Make your choice between these, said Joshua, if you are dissatisfied with Jehovah.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXXIII

prompt.en: Blaikie finds a defect in Joshua not as a believer but as a military ____ whose conquests did not always endure.
prompt.es: Blaikie halla un defecto en Josué no como creyente sino como ____ militar cuyas conquistas no siempre perduraron.

questions.source_quote: If we examine carefully Joshua's character as a soldier, or rather as a strategist, we shall probably find that he had one defect.

questions.source_heading: Blaikie, The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Joshua, chapter XXXIII

prompt.en: For Blaikie, Joshua granted his people comparative rest by giving them settled ____ of their own.
prompt.es: Para Blaikie, Josué dio a su pueblo un descanso relativo al proporcionarles ____ estables y propios.

questions.source_quote: Joshua gave them rest in the sense that he gave them homes of their own.
